source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 39 (amended by Mah. Act 20 of 2015)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 39 (both columns, IGR text): 'MEMORANDUM OF ASSOCIATION OF A COMPANY — (a) if accompanied by articles of association under section 26 of the Companies Act, 1956 — One thousand rupees; (b) if not so accompanied — 0.2 per cent according to the share capital of the company, subject to minimum of rupees one thousand and maximum of rupees 50,00,000.'

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official IGR text). The Maharashtra CAP showcase (PRD §5.2 — caps are load-bearing and a differentiator): MOA not accompanied by AoA → 0.2% of share_capital, floor Rs 1,000, CAP Rs 50,00,000. accompanied_by_aoa='yes' → flat Rs 1,000. Instrument key memorandum_of_association is outside the MVP-15 but encoded to exercise the cap primitive; harmless (validator warns, non-blocking). Could be dropped if the founder prefers strict MVP-15 scope.

source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 48(a)-(e),(h) (Rs 500 subst. for Rs 100 by Mah. 20 of 2015)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 48 (both columns, IGR text): 'POWER OF ATTORNEY not being a Proxy — (a) sole purpose of procuring registration ... single transaction — Five hundred rupees; (b) suits under Presidency Small Cause Courts Act — Five hundred rupees; (c) authorising one or more persons to act in a single transaction other than (a) — Five hundred rupees; (d) authorising one person to act in more than one transaction or generally — Five hundred rupees; (e) authorising more than one person ... jointly or severally or generally — Five hundred rupees; (h) in any other case — Five hundred rupees for each person authorised.' [All Rs 100 → Rs 500 by Mah. 20 of 2015 w.e.f. 24-5-2015.] Clause (f)(i): for consideration authorising sale of immovable property — same duty as Conveyance (Art 25) on market value. Clause (f)(ii)(a): to sell/transfer without consideration to father/mother/brother/sister/wife/husband/daughter/son/grandson/granddaughter or spouse's such relatives — Rs 500; else (f)(ii)(b) — Conveyance rate. Clause (g): to a promoter/developer for construction/development/sale/transfer — Conveyance rate (s.32A applies; Rs 100 if proper duty paid under Art 5(g-a) agreement between same parties).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH for clauses (a)-(e),(h) = Rs 500 (official IGR). ESCALATIONS for the questionnaire (NOT this flat rule): clause (f) POA for consideration to sell immovable → Conveyance rate on market value (the GPA-for-sale avoidance pattern); (f)(ii)(a) family gift-POA → Rs 500; (g) developer/promoter POA → Conveyance rate (with the s.32A market-value provisions and the Rs 100 set-off where Art 5(g-a) agreement duty paid). These forks belong in Flow B. effective_from 2015-05-24 = the Rs 100→Rs 500 change; the pre-2015 Rs 100 version is a back-catalogue item (M2).

source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 48(a)-(e),(h) as they stood before Mah. Act 20 of 2015 s.20(25)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 48 clauses (a)-(e) and (h) PRIOR to Mah. 20 of 2015: 'One hundred rupees' each — substituted by 'Five hundred rupees' w.e.f. 24-5-2015 (IGR footnotes 20(25)(i)-(v)).

notes_for_reviewer: BACK-CATALOGUE (2015-01-01 → 2015-05-23): POA Rs 100 before Mah. 20 of 2015 raised it to Rs 500 w.e.f. 24-5-2015.
